name: category-nav
title: Category nav
description: A category tree that shows only the current branch: parents above, siblings beside, children below, with counts.
docs: tree is the top-level categories as { id, label, href, count?, children? }; currentId says where you are (leave it out at the top, where 'All categories' is the current one). Only that branch is drawn: a link back to all categories, the parents as links, the categories beside the current one (showSiblings), the current one in bold with aria-current='page', and its children indented with counts. More children than maxChildren (6) fold under 'Show N more', and the button stays where it is so the focus is never lost; a fold of a single category is not made. A category with a count of 0 is dimmed, not removed. onNavigate(category, event) runs on a click: call event.preventDefault() to route on the client. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link, allHref is where 'All categories' goes, showCounts turns the counts off, and labels holds the fixed words. It is one nav landmark named Categories and renders on the server.
